messages:
maria: Quick sync 3 Orchid Bank POC next week. They want drop-in compat with CompetitorZ for transaction-summary. Main asks: shim, parity test, pricing bridge, and a short security packet.

ben: I'll build a small adapter that maps CompetitorZ's `text` response and `stop_sequences[]` to our `outputs` array and single `stop`. Will include trimming/normalize step to reduce diffs.

kevin: For parity, capture 500 representative prompts, run both endpoints, score by embedding cosine (flag <0.9) and normalized edit distance. Manual review for top 100.

zara: Security: they require KMS + EU data residency. We can run POC on Private in eu-central-1 and provide SOC2 summary + KMS onboarding notes.

maria: Pricing ask: they want a 90-day match to CompetitorZ rates. Sales suggests bridge: match for first 1M calls or 2-week discounted Dedicated trial.

ben: Determinism note: set temp=0/top_p=0 reduces variance but won't guarantee exact tokens. Shim will canonicalize whitespace/punctuation.

infra-bot: eu-central-1 GPUs available: 3. Reservation ticket R-998 created.

maria: Action items: ben adapter PoC, kevin prompt set + scoring scripts, zara security packet. Meeting Fri 9am to review demo.

kevin: I'll anonymize prompts and run DLP before sharing.

maria: Good. I'll prep the bridge offer draft and attach to the runbook. :rocket:
